# Green Turtle Trades

> Green Turtle Trades Limited is an Edinburgh company developing an alternative investment platform for UK professional clients and copy trading technology for independent traders. GTT reviews trading records, filters trade instructions and calculates investor allocations for execution at its designated broker. Investment management is intended to sit with the regulated host firm. We are onboarding traders now and welcome discussions with prospective UK professional clients. The investment platform is in development and is not yet available.

Legal entity: Green Turtle Trades Limited. Company number: SC878660.

## Current availability

We are onboarding traders now and welcome discussions with prospective UK professional clients. The investment platform is in development and is not yet available.

## Traders

GTT is onboarding independent traders for its proposed copy trading platform. Approved MT4 and MT5 source broker accounts can be retained, subject to permission and compatibility. Records, strategy and risk are reviewed before any copying arrangement. Applying does not guarantee selection, a contract or investor capital.

## Professional investors

The proposed alternative investment platform is for UK professional clients only. GTT welcomes prospective client discussions, but the investment platform is not yet available. GTT provides verification, trade filtering, allocation calculations and reporting; client capital and execution sit with the designated broker, with investment management intended to sit with the regulated host firm. An enquiry does not establish eligibility.

## Supporting products

Turtle Analytics and trading journals support historical performance and risk review. The university competition uses virtual capital; competition results are distinct from a verified live trading record and from selection for the proposed investment service.

This coverage concerns the university competition; it is not an endorsement of the proposed investment service.

## Names and interpretation

Green Turtle Trades is the brand. Green Turtle Traders is a domain/name variation, not a separate company. Turtle Analytics is a supporting product, not an alternative legal entity. The company does not provide the historical Turtle Trading strategy.

Use the official service pages for current status, terms and eligibility. Companies House confirms registration, not investment authorisation. Trading involves risk and past performance does not guarantee future results.
